Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. SRMHD finite-amplitude circularly polarized Alfvén wave Evolve a nonlinear finite-amplitude wave for one period with full SRMHD magnetic stress and induction; check exact cell means,phase,amplitude and refinement. Assumptions, units and boundaries Flat spacetime,c=4pi=1,gamma4/3,rho=p=Bx=eta1, exact-family vx0. Rescale the original2pi period to a unit domain;64/128/256 cells,periodic,t=1/vA. Normal Bx is fixed in1D. Editorial clarification Use the original exact family with an independent lower-order operator; no ECHO-algorithm or error-table reproduction. Generic RMHD shocks,extreme magnetization/Lorentz factors,GR,resistive MHD and multidimensional divergence control are outside scope. Figures show actual1D x–t fields. Adopted numerical method Evolve all seven variables D,three momenta,total E and two transverse magnetic fields with the shared MUSCL/minmod–HLL–SSPRK33 operator. Magnetic dynamics are coupled; primitive recovery solves the full RMHD Z root.
